caseName: Madden v. Mac Sim Bar Paper Co.
caseNameFull: Madden, Doing Business as Kohl & Madden Printing Ink Co. v. Mac Sim Bar Paper Co.
attorneys: Mr. Harry C. Howard for petitioner. Mr. Marvin J. Schaberg for respondent.
judges: Are, Black, Granted, Should, That, Writ

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.’

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that the petition for writ of certiorari should be granted.
